src/com/example/Edges.kt:21:53: ComposeUnstableCollections: The Compose Compiler cannot infer the stability of a parameter if a List<Int> is used in it, even if the item type is stable. You should use Kotlinx Immutable Collections instead: `items: ImmutableList<Int>` or create an `@Immutable` wrapper for this class: `@Immutable data class ItemsList(val items: List<Int>)` See https://slackhq.github.io/compose-lints/rules/#avoid-using-unstable-collections for more information.
src/com/example/Edges.kt:22:13: ComposeViewModelForwarding: Forwarding a ViewModel through multiple @Composable functions should be avoided. Consider using state hoisting. See https://slackhq.github.io/compose-lints/rules/#hoist-all-the-things for more information.
src/com/example/Edges.kt:25:5: ComposeViewModelInjection: Implicit dependencies of composables should be made explicit. Usages of myFactory to acquire a ViewModel should be done in composable default parameters, so that it is more testable and flexible. See https://slackhq.github.io/compose-lints/rules/#viewmodels for more information.
